entries.label: SaintLogic — étage du prototype KODOQUE
entries.scene: SaintLogic Prototype KODOQUE factory platform from AC!D2. OMIT the machine and all characters. Preserve the actual teal green industrial floor and wall panels, straight recessed parallel steel tracks with black/yellow edges, bright pale mint-green rectangular lift/work platform with X-braced sides and the white stencil '02' on its dark center, yellow-orange border lines, low stacks of rectangular olive cargo crates, simple yellow tubular service railings. Match the original cel-shaded saturated green/yellow PSP aesthetic, not a realistic grey hangar. Show one representative factory level, with the numbered platform in the midground and a clear flat green metal foreground lane. No unreferenced robot cradle or sci-fi holograms.
